## Functions

### `Kbd`

```ts
Kbd(props: KbdProps): Html
```

A keycap, or a chord of them — for shortcuts in menus, tooltips and docs.

## Types

### `KbdSize`

- `"sm"`
- `"md"`

### `KbdProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `keys` | `string | string[]` | yes | One key, or several rendered as a chord (`["⌘", "K"]`). |
| `size` | `KbdSize` |  |  |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### A shortcut in a sentence

```ts
html`
  <p>Press ${Kbd({ keys: ["⌘", "K"] })} to search.</p>
`
```

```html
<p>
  Press
  <kbd class="kbd kbd--chord">
    <kbd class="kbd__key">⌘</kbd>
    <span class="kbd__plus" aria-hidden="true">+</span>
    <kbd class="kbd__key">K</kbd>
  </kbd>
  to search.
</p>
```

### A single key, small

```ts
Kbd({ keys: "Esc", size: "sm" })
```

```html
<kbd class="kbd kbd__key kbd--sm">Esc</kbd>
```

## CSS hooks

Classes defined by `components/kbd/kbd.css` — structural, token-driven; override from an unlayered stylesheet (see [Theming](../UI-Theming.md)):

`.kbd`, `.kbd--sm`, `.kbd__key`, `.kbd__plus`
